name: skeleton-block
title: Skeleton Block
description: An Operator Black skeleton block built from deterministic solid loading rows.

variables.label: Rows
variables.description: Number of loading rows in the block. Values outside the range are clamped to it.

variables.label: Density
variables.description: Height of each row and the gap between them.

variables.label: Fill
variables.description: Width of the title bar inside each row, as a percent of the row. Values outside the range are clamped to it.

variables.label: Slide
variables.description: Scales the sideways travel the timeline drives, so rows settle from closer in or further out in the same time.
